newsitem.title: UK: Royal Sun up on share buyback announcement.
newsitem.headline: Royal Sun up on share buyback announcement.

text.p: Shares in Royal Sun Alliance Group Plc jumped on Thursday, coming within one penny of its 1997 peak hit on February 11, after the company said it sought to buy back up to five percent of share capital.
At 0850 GMT, the shares were up 7-1/2p to 511, having climbed as high as 515 initially.
Turnover was 2.0 million shares, placing it among London's most actively traded stocks.
In releasing its annual results, the UK insurance concern said it would seek shareholder approval for the share repurchase.
However, dealers said further gains would be difficult since the share buyback isn't definite.
"They're only seeking approval. Their balance sheet has to be strong enough to actually do it," said one.
Royal Sun posted annual pre-exceptional operating profits of 706 million stg. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
